scientific_limitations: Exact for one-dimensional unbounded drift diffusion with independent Poisson resetting and two exponential point-local-time sinks; does not optimize resetting rate or target positions. Broader rank-two resolvent allocation results may imply this special classification.
title: A sharp reactivity-budget transition for two drift-biased resetting traps
